title: carex ampullacea subsp. rotundata
intro: Carex ampullacea subsp. rotundata, commonly known as the Round-stemmed Sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to provide relief from various health issues due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of Carex ampullacea subsp. rotundata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its health benefits such as wound healing, immune system support, and the management of digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
